title: Deposited sequence databases are typically 1.7 years old, and 42% are older than two years
sub:
PRIDE datasets released 2013–2025. a, b: age of the main FASTA at submission, from a high-confidence date in its file name (2,558 datasets, 1,305
groups; median 1.67 y, 95% CI 1.58–1.80; >1 y 69%, >5 y 8%). A name date may be a download, release or tool build date, so ages are approximate.
